title: Italy's CSIRT (ACN) bulletin warns of compromise campaigns run with autonomous AI agents
date_note: Cybersecurity360 gives 23 November 2026 as the publication date of the CSIRT Italia bulletin BL01/261123/CSIRT-ITA; the bulletin itself was not opened.
summary: Cybersecurity360 reports that CSIRT Italia, part of Italy's national cybersecurity agency ACN, published bulletin BL01/261123/CSIRT-ITA on 23 November on mass compromise campaigns in Italy. Cybertrends says ACN describes autonomous AI agents that find misconfigurations and chain vulnerabilities. Cybersecurity360 says ACN reports numerous systems breached within a few hours and names ARTEX among the tools.
plain: Italy's national cybersecurity agency warns that attackers are using autonomous AI agents that can break into numerous systems within a few hours.
exec: ACN's bulletin, as reported, says AI agents speed up attacks, so exposed and unpatched systems are at greater risk.
action: As ACN's bulletin advises (per Cybersecurity360): update exposed systems as quickly as possible, apply MFA and least privilege, and isolate systems that cannot be patched.
geo_basis: campaigns reported in Italy by the national CSIRT; no city stated for victims; pin placed in Italy

validation.note: Cybersecurity360 and Cybersecurity Trends are independent Italian publishers that each report the ACN/CSIRT Italia bulletin and its AI-agent findings; the bulletin page itself was not cited.

review.note: bulletin date, AI agents, ARTEX and advice match both sources
